results.title: Is Tesla's pivot to robotics coming at the cost of its car business? - USA Today
results.content: Is Tesla's pivot to robotics coming at the cost of its car business? Tesla CEO Elon Musk's political presence since buying Twitter, now X, in 2022 has cost the car company more than a million car sales in the United States, according to a Yale study. Tesla is rolling out plans to build robots and semi trucks to the delight of its investors, but auto industry analysts are wondering if the company is at risk of neglecting its core car business. "Tesla faced a tough year in 2025, a second tough year in a row, because its product line is aging, and the company hasn't been able to bring a high‑volume product to market to offset that," Stephanie Valdez Streaty, director of industry insights at Cox Automotive, said in a statement, noting that Tesla has done little at the start of 2026 to alter its car fortunes.
